name: iter_es_normal
description: COMPANION-PROTOCOL SETTING 1 (STANDARD): the three mix policies with early stopping restored - the companion paper's own retraining protocol, which the round-1 probe showed is what makes the single-round advantage visible (iteration-1 gap -0.128 vs -0.002 under the fixed 400-epoch budget that lets both arms converge and wash it out). Operating point otherwise unchanged (sigma 0.5, alpha0 0.5, 100 points/round), K=8, 15 seeds.
